workers_feature_databases_description: Registers SQLite files on this computer, shows them in a view where you browse and edit them, and gives agents tools to query and change them under your approvals.
workers_databases_empty_description: Add an existing SQLite file to browse it here and to let agents query it.
workers_databases_list_failed: The databases could not be listed.
workers_databases_none_selected_descript: Pick a database in the sidebar to see its tables, structure and data.
workers_databases_not_found: This database is no longer registered.
workers_databases_add_description: Choose an existing SQLite file on this computer. Mannie never creates, moves or copies the file.
workers_databases_add_name_hint: Leave it empty to use the file's name.
workers_databases_add_read_only_hint: The view and agents only read it.
workers_databases_remove_description: Mannie forgets the database. The file stays as it is, and you can add it again.
workers_databases_unusable_missing: The file is gone. Put it back and choose Refresh, or remove the database.
workers_databases_unusable_changed: Another file is at this path now, such as after a program replaced it. Accept it to use it here.
workers_databases_unusable_unreadable: The file cannot be read. Check that Mannie may open it, then choose Refresh.
workers_databases_tables_empty: This database has no tables or views.
workers_databases_data_copy_failed: The page could not be copied.
workers_databases_data_select_page: Select every row of the page
workers_databases_data_view_note: A view has no key that names its rows, so its rows cannot be edited here.
workers_databases_data_delete_descriptio: Each row is deleted only while it still has the values shown, and all of them or none are deleted. This cannot be undone.
workers_databases_sql_cut_rows: The result stops at the view's row limit. Narrow the statement with WHERE or LIMIT.
workers_databases_sql_cut_bytes: The result stops at the view's size limit. Select fewer columns or rows.
workers_databases_sql_schema_description: This statement changes the structure of {name}. Agents and programs that use the database may stop working.
workers_databases_sql_read_only: This database is read-only, so only statements that read run here.
workers_databases_error_name_taken: Another database has this name. Choose another one.
workers_databases_error_not_registered: The database is no longer registered.
workers_databases_error_too_many_files: Mannie keeps no more databases. Remove one first.
workers_databases_error_file_refused_lin: The file is a link. Choose the file that it leads to.
workers_databases_error_file_refused_net: The file is on another computer. Choose a file on this computer.
workers_databases_error_file_refused_com: This is a file that SQLite keeps beside a database. Choose the database itself.
workers_databases_error_file_refused_man: The file is inside Mannie's own folders, which no database may be in.
workers_databases_error_file_refused_not: The file is not a SQLite database.
The path does not name a file.
workers_databases_error_file_changed: Another file is at the database's path now. Accept it first.
workers_databases_error_not_a_database: The file is not a SQLite database, or it is damaged.
workers_databases_error_marked_read_only: The database is marked read-only. Allow changes first.
workers_databases_error_read_only_host: The worker's host only reads, so it runs no changes.
workers_databases_error_file_read_only: The system does not let Mannie write this file.
workers_databases_error_invalid_name: A name has 1 to 100 characters and no line breaks.
workers_databases_error_invalid_filter: The file dialog could not open.
workers_databases_error_schema_too_large: The database's schema is too large for Mannie to check a statement against a copy of it.
workers_databases_error_parameters: The statement takes {expected} values, and {given} were given.
workers_databases_error_refused: Mannie never runs this statement, such as ATTACH, a transaction or a pragma that writes: {message}
workers_databases_error_schema_unconfirm: Confirm the change of the schema first.
workers_databases_error_busy: Another program is using the file. Try again in a moment.
workers_databases_error_timed_out: The statement took too long and was stopped. Narrow it with WHERE or LIMIT.
workers_databases_error_constraint: The change broke a constraint, and nothing changed: {message}
workers_databases_error_row_changed: The row changed since it was shown. Show the rows again and retry.
workers_databases_error_no_key: This table has no key that names one row.
workers_databases_error_not_allowed: The change was not the one that was allowed, and nothing changed.
workers_databases_error_no_dialog: This computer has no file dialog.
workers_databases_error_failed: Mannie could not work with the database. The log has the cause.
workers_databases_tool_unknown_database: No registered database has this name.
workers_databases_tool_database_unusable: The database cannot be used now.
workers_databases_tool_invalid_arguments: The call's arguments did not fit the tool.
workers_databases_tool_constraint: The change broke a constraint, and nothing changed.
workers_databases_tool_refused: Mannie never runs this statement, such as ATTACH, a transaction or a pragma that writes.
workers_databases_tool_parameters: The statement got another number of values than it takes.
workers_databases_mention_not_found: This database is no longer registered.
workers_databases_failure_unavailable: The registered databases could not be listed. The log has the cause.

match.countPlural=one: A statement of the Databases view is running. A read stops, and a change runs to its end.
match.countPlural=other: {count} statements of the Databases view are running. Reads stop, and changes run to their end.

workers_list_failed_title: The workers could not be shown
workers_pair_description: Enter the address and code that mannie-worker pair prints on the worker's host.
workers_pair_address_description: The host's name or address, with the port when it is not 7445.
workers_pair_code_description: The code that mannie-worker pair printed. It works once, for 10 minutes.
workers_pair_name_description: The name that Mannie and its assistant use for the worker. Leave it empty to use the name in the worker's configuration.
workers_remove_description: The worker forgets this app and cancels its tasks. A worker that is offline keeps its pairing until you run mannie-worker pair --reset on its host. The conversations of its tasks stay in their parents, but can no longer be read.
workers_rename_description: Mannie and its assistant call the worker by this name. Leave it empty to use the name in the worker's configuration.
workers_error_address_invalid: Enter the host's name or address, with :port when the port is not 7445.
workers_error_unreachable: The worker could not be reached. Check the address, that the worker runs, and that the host's firewall lets this computer reach the port.
workers_error_not_a_worker: Something that is not a Mannie worker answered at this address. Check the address and the port.
workers_error_code_refused: The worker refused the code. Check it, or run mannie-worker pair on the host again for a new one: a code works once, for 10 minutes.
workers_error_too_many_attempts: The code was tried too often and no longer works. Run mannie-worker pair on the host again for a new one.
workers_error_already_paired: The worker is paired with another Mannie. Run mannie-worker pair --reset on its host, then pair it again.
workers_error_already_added: This worker is paired with this Mannie already.
workers_error_key_changed: The worker's key changed. Remove the worker, then pair it again.
workers_error_incompatible: The worker runs version {version}, which this Mannie does not work with. Update the worker on its host with mannie-worker update.
workers_error_worker_not_found: The worker is no longer paired.
workers_error_name_invalid: A worker's name has at most {maxCharacters} characters.
workers_error_name_taken: Another worker has this name. Choose a different one.
workers_error_credential_store_unavailab: The credential store, which keeps this computer's key for its workers, could not be used. Unlock it, then try again.
workers_error_storage_failed: The worker could not be saved. The log in Mannie's data folder has the cause.
workers_settings_description: The computers that run tasks for Mannie, and how they connect.
workers_settings_empty_description: A worker runs tasks for Mannie on another computer. Install mannie-worker there as a service, run mannie-worker pair on it, then pair it here.
workers_settings_update_hint: This worker needs the version of this Mannie. Update it on its host with mannie-worker update.
workers_settings_ceiling_ask: Asks before every change and command
workers_settings_ceiling_autonomous: Changes the allowed folders and runs the allowed commands without asking
workers_settings_ceiling_full_access: Changes files and runs commands anywhere on the host without asking
workers_settings_master_full_access_answ: Answers the host's requests without asking you
workers_plugin_description: Lets the conversation agent give tasks to Mannie's workers on other Windows, Linux and FreeBSD computers.

match.countPlural=one: A worker task is running. It keeps running on its worker, its approval requests wait there, and Mannie follows it again when you turn Workers back on.
match.countPlural=other: {count: number} worker tasks are running. They keep running on their workers, their approval requests wait there, and Mannie follows them again when you turn Workers back on.

workers_plugin_failure_storage_failed: Mannie could not read the paired workers. Check the log, then try again.
workers_task_detached: Mannie stopped following this task. The worker may still run it, and its conversation shows what happened since.
workers_task_read_only: This conversation belongs to a task on a worker. Its parent conversation gives it work.
workers_refusal_worker_offline: No task started: the worker {worker} is not connected.
workers_refusal_worker_unknown: No task started: no paired worker is named {worker}.
workers_refusal_worker_incompatible: No task started: the worker {worker} runs a version of Mannie that this one does not work with. Update it on its host.
workers_refusal_profile_not_reachable: No task started: the provider profile uses an address on this computer, which the worker {worker} cannot reach.
workers_refusal_still_running: No task started: the worker {worker} still works on an earlier task of this conversation.
